THE HERTZ CORPORATION FILED FOR BANKRUPTCY ON MAY 22, 2020, AND PRE-DATES THE FILING OF THIS CLAIM. PROCEEDINGS WERE STAYED AT THE TIME OF THE JUDGMENT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK.
